en: Tell me about something else...

Plenty of good mining to be had in Durotar, or so I hear.  So good in fact that we have a Mining Trainer right here in Razor Hill.  You'll find Krunn next to the heated forge in the northwest corner of town.

You have outgrown any teachings I could offer. Go with the blessing of the Earth Mother. Seek out the tauren Tarn in the northwestern shops of Thunder Bluff's central plateau. Be guided by his wisdom.
The spirits are restless!
Sandwich?  What?  You makin' a sandwich for me, pop?
Hi there! The name's Gregan. What can I do for ya?
Who says orcs aren't smart? It takes a lot of brains to be an engineer!
Help!! I told you this place was cursed!
Greetings Citizens!  Soon perhaps the tide will turn in our favor and the plague will end.
I believe Simone was looking for you earlier, $n. Have you spoken with her yet?
A happy Winter's Vale to you, friend!
It... is... not... the best... time, $n. I must concen... trate.
Fantastic then!  Let's get this thing fixed for you.

Ah, a good question.$B$BIf you prefer hunting in the great outdoors, there are elementals here in the Plaguelands, Azshara, Burning Steppes, Felwood, Silithus, Winterspring, and even Un'Goro Crater.$B$BIf you are the type that laughs in the face of danger, then perhaps you should visit Dire Maul. I have heard that a great many elemental abberations exist within its walls. You would also do well in seeking out the elementals employed by the Dark Iron dwarves of Blackrock Depths.

Glyx and I have an understanding: he keeps me supplied, and I keep him rich. Seriously! What that pirate charges me for a measly pouch of crumpled kingsblood... it's enough to make a grown goblin cry.
For Broxigar!
What is Juju?
Take it, then. It seems Zygand is too busy for the agonizing trip here to retrieve it himself.
The Stormpike Aid Station is in Dun Baldar, right outside the Dun Baldar barracks.$B$BThe Horde currently controls it.

Yes, I have seen the shaman you seek. Last I saw her, she was to the west of here. She hides in the hills above the Razormane tribe. If you're clever, you'll be able to find a path to her hut in the hills. It is not too far north of here. That path should allow you to find her without fighting through the quilboar.
Poor Dorius. If I ever get my hands on those Dark Irons, so help me...
Wulan in Shadowprey Village can sell you the "Expert Cookbook".  You will need that if you are to better yourself.
There's an excellent skinner that lives up in the house by Crystal Lake.  She's bound to be able to show you how to get started in the skinner's profession.
We're almost to safety. From here, we run. Try not to get too far behind! GO!
I am ready for the illusion, Myranda.
Explorer reporting!....Excellent!
Shall we slay them for the impertinence of disturbing our sleep?
Victory for the Horde!
I don't have time to chat, citizen, but if you're willing to give us a hand against the orcs, then I'll find a use for you.
Ah, hits the spot!
Zul'Farrak
I have completed your helm, $n.

Woo hoo, here we go! Everyone's collected everything, and it's all being airlifted via zeppelin to Silithus as we speak. The last of it should be there in less than a day. Once it's all over there, and the scepter has been assembled, the war against those dirty insects can begin. As they say, 'Ship It!'
This plant stands out among the normal flora of Teldrassil, and emits a strange, purplish glow.
The Grand Crusader has charged me with destroying you and your newfound friends, Taelan, but know this: I do this for pleasure, not of obligation or duty.
The Blood God, the Soulflayer, has been defeated!  We are imperiled no longer!
Messengers from Ravenholdt delivered this letter to me this morning. It is addressed to you, $n.
You found a key?  Well, is it THE key?  I mean, is it the key to unlock these shackles?  Well $G sir : ma'am;, there is only one way to find out!
Praise the Light, one has finally answered the calling.

The Inn?  Ah, ye looking to toss back some of the best ales Ironforge has to offer?  The Stonefire Tavern is where ye'll want to go.  $B$BYe'll find it just to the left of the entrance to Ironforge if ye be coming, or to the right if ye be going.
I. . .I. . .don't. . .feel. . .right. . .
How dare you defile this ancient place!
Let me browse your seasonal fare.
A-Me, home. A-Me go home! $n, no stop A-Me.
%s overloads!
Intruders!!
Greetings and salutations from the manor Ravenholdt, adventurer.
$950w, soldier.
